name: GE-Proton11-12 Released
body:
# GE-Proton11-12

Changes since GE-Proton11-11.

## Component Updates

- Wine: Valve bleeding-edge 2026-10-31, plus newer bleeding-edge commits:
  - XInput now rescans controllers only when a device could have changed. This replaces the Far Cry 4 and Witcher 3 rescan hacks.
  - The thread pool worker timeout is now 60 seconds.
  - Voice Capture DSP (`mfwmaaec`) supports audio capture.
  - HID input reports are cut to their declared length.
  - The Radeon Software version is now set in the registry.
  - nvapi is disabled for every game when the NVIDIA driver isn't loaded.
  - Xalia was updated to 0.5.0.1.
  - wineopenxr was updated to OpenXR 1.1.65, adds initial support for D3D-consumed swapchains and fixes extension string lengths.
  - lsteamclient: better path resolution for `ISteamApps::GetFileDetails()`, and matchmaking request handles are now validated.
- DXVK: v3.1.1-174:
  - Command submission throttling and memory eviction rework.
  - Present timing fixes, including an NVIDIA fence workaround.
  - D3D9 YUV conversion fix and D3D11 `ForcedSampleCount` fix.
- D7VK: large DirectDraw/D3D7 and older rework:
  - Viewport, material and texture objects are shared between interface versions.
  - Gamma, display mode and present handling fixes.
  - New legacy aspect-ratio and overlay options.
- VKD3D-Proton: v3.1:
  - Arc Raiders wave32 workaround.
  - UE4 ray tracing glitch fix on AMD.
  - Memory allocation fallback across memory types.
  - Fence event and present timing fixes.
- VKD3D: shader compiler updates (HLSL namespaces, `.mips[][]`, d3dbc parsing).
- DXVK-NVAPI: v0.9.3. Available video memory now matches `nvidia-smi`.
- FEX: FEX-2610-116. Adds AVX-NE-CONVERT and x87 FIP, plus decoder fixes.
- DXVK, D7VK and VKD3D-Proton built from a GE-patched tree now carry `-GE-Proton(dirty)` in their version string. This lets upstream developers see in bug reports that the build is modified.

## Controllers

- Final Fantasy VII Rebirth, Horizon Forbidden West and Horizon Zero Dawn Remastered: DualSense haptics and adaptive triggers now work together over USB. These games now default to `PROTON_SONY_WINDOWS_DEVICE_NAMES=1` ([#860](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/860)).
- Armored Core VI: controllers now work through the Steam Input fallback with Steam Input disabled. Previously the game received no input.
- The automatic Sony Steam Input fallback is kept when Steam Input is disabled for one game but enabled globally for PlayStation controllers.
- Added `PROTON_STEAM_INPUT_XBOX_PROMPTS`. It reports the Steam Deck and Steam Controller as an Xbox controller, so games show controller prompts instead of keyboard prompts. Enabled by default for Rune Factory 5 ([#841](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/841)).
- Where Winds Meet now defaults to `PROTON_SONY_AUTO_XINPUT=0`, which fixes the DualSense touchpad not working until replugged ([#829](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/829)).
- The Forest: fixed a crash when joining a dedicated server from the in-game browser.

## Steam Overlay

- Wine-Wayland on niri and other Smithay compositors: fixed the overlay cursor drifting or staying in place, and the overlay responding late to input ([#904](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/pull/904), thanks @yahya637).
- Fixed the overlay cursor freezing in pointer-locked games on compositors that skip `wl_pointer.frame`.

## Wayland and Windowing

- Hyprland: fixed fullscreen games dropping to a tiled or maximized window. Examples are UT2004 rendering into a tile-sized viewport and UT4 losing fullscreen at the menu. This was a regression since GE-Proton11-7 ([#871](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/871)).
- Fixed IME input (Fcitx5) freezing games with `PROTON_ENABLE_WAYLAND=1` ([#798](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/798)).
- Fixed a Wine-Wayland deadlock during present and focus changes, and a hang on exit, in Galaxy Idle Clicker ([#908](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/908)).
- GNOME: fixed tray icons of Wine-Wayland applications not appearing. This was a regression in GE-Proton11-11 ([#872](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/872)).
- Wine-Wayland: animated game cursors now animate ([#919](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/919)).
- RuneScape (Vulkan beta): fixed the game window never appearing on Wine-Wayland with NVIDIA and antialiasing enabled ([#837](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/837)).
- Cinnamon: windows keep their title bars and borders again. GE-Proton now treats Muffin as its own window manager, like Valve's Proton does ([#767](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/767)).
- X11: games no longer hang waiting for a pointer grab on focus changes ([#920](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/pull/920), thanks @Syrupdesu).
- Layered overlay windows such as Desktop Mate ([#897](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/pull/897), thanks @Mihnea8848):
  - Fast readback is now kept for windows larger than the screen.
  - New opt-in `WINE_LAYERED_OVERLAY_DIRECT=1` presents directly, which avoids duplicated or skipped frames.
- Fixed DXVK and VKD3D-Proton device creation failing on Wayland when an OpenXR runtime is installed. This affected DayZ ([#852](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/852)).

## Video Playback

- MSFS 2024: 4K intro videos no longer play in slow motion. The faster GPU conversion path is enabled again ([#389](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/389)).
- Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest: intro videos with AAC audio no longer stop playback before the main menu ([#882](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/882)).
- VRChat TopazPlayer: RTSP streams are now reported as live, so AVPro Video no longer reloads them as stalled. Patch by @l12436 ([#896](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/896)).
- The Godfather: FMVs no longer flicker or flash at the edges ([#909](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/pull/909), thanks @AITUS95).
- Arcade and Konami movie fixes, thanks @aderumier ([#880](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/pull/880), [#884](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/pull/884), [#894](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/pull/894), [#895](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/pull/895), [#905](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/pull/905), [#915](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/pull/915), [#918](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/pull/918)):
  - Silent Hill: The Arcade: movies no longer stay black.
  - Cooper's 9: MP42 movies play.
  - Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's Duel Terminal 6: mode previews no longer turn grey.
  - Wangan Midnight Maximum Tune 5: WMV movies play.
  - Need for Speed Underground (Global VR): no longer crashes at the first movie frame.
  - Madden NFL Football Season 2 (Global VR): no longer crashes at the end of attract movies.
  - PGA TOUR Golf Championship Edition III: gray blocks after fades are gone.
- khdays-port: the game now gets past the first cutscene. Fixes a work queue shutdown deadlock ([#899](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/899)).

## Rendering and HDR

- RuneScape: colors no longer look washed out. Swapchains now report the same first surface format as Windows ([#837](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/837)).
- KDE Plasma 6.8: MangoHud and the Steam overlay no longer look oversaturated in HDR10 games on Wine-Wayland. `WINE_WAYLAND_HDR_PASSTHROUGH=1` restores the previous behavior ([#898](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/898), [#916](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/916)).
- HDR detection on KDE no longer uses KWin's private protocol and now uses the same standard check as other compositors ([#838](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/838)).
  - Added `PROTON_FORCE_HDR=1`. It reports HDR when KDE's SDR brightness is set to the monitor's peak, and on compositors that switch to HDR only for fullscreen HDR clients, such as Hyprland's `cm_auto_hdr`.
- Star Citizen: DLSS works on NVIDIA again without disabling bottom-up allocation. GE-Proton now keeps free the address range the NVIDIA driver reserves for DLSS.
- Titanfall 2 and the EA app on Wine-Wayland with NVIDIA: fixed the EA app crashing at startup. This works around an NVIDIA driver bug when Vulkan instances are destroyed ([#881](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/881)).
- Arc Raiders: fixed an NVIDIA crash when the window is unfocused while a level loads ([#891](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/891)).
- StarCraft II: the GPU hang workaround now applies only to Navi 10 (RX 5000) GPUs. Other GPUs keep constant buffer streaming ([#845](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/845)).
- Warhammer 40,000: Darktide: on AMD-only systems the game now uses its native AGS library without `amdxc64`, restoring the FSR 4 option on RDNA3. This is skipped when `PROTON_FSR4_UPGRADE` is set or `amdxc64` is overridden ([#869](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/869)).

## Protonfixes

- Added `PROTON_STREAMLINE_UPGRADE`. It downloads a current NVIDIA Streamline so the DLSS frame generation override works in games that ship an old one ([#875](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/875)).
- Upscalers:
  - User-defined DLLs can now be passed.
  - `PROTON_FSR4_UPGRADE` and `PROTON_MLFG_UPGRADE` are now passed through.
  - The FFX4 version is controlled through the FSR4 version when OptiScaler is used.
  - Setup is skipped when the fix's conditions aren't met.
- The Witcher 3: the Wine version is hidden for the other store versions too ([#879](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/879)).
- Kingdoms of Amalur: Re-Reckoning: installs `d3dcompiler_43` and `d3dcompiler_47` ([umu-database#159](https://github.com/Open-Wine-Components/umu-database/issues/159)).
- Star Citizen:
  - The libcuda workaround was replaced by the DLSS address-range fix above.
  - `PROTON_DLL_COPY` is applied early for the .NET install.
- Added a fix for Ultima Online (ClassicUO Launcher).
- Removed the Gray Zone Warfare EAC hash fix.
- Updated the umu database.
- The protonfixes debug output now shows the Proton build and the prefix version.

## Other Changes

- Helldivers 2:
  - Fixed a memory leak of about 34 GiB of address space and 360 MiB of RAM per hour ([#917](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/pull/917), thanks @jegglest).
  - Fixed threads and file descriptors piling up during a session ([#921](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/pull/921), thanks @jegglest).
  - Both leaks come from killed threads not being cleaned up.
- Fixed unbounded heap growth. In EVE Online with 5 clients, memory growth went from 292 MiB/h to 28.5 MiB/h ([#907](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/pull/907), thanks @greg2010).
- Space Marine 2: fixed crashes after long play sessions. This is Proton-JE's `RtlWaitOnAddress()` fix.
- ntsync: a mutex whose owner dies is now abandoned even after its handles were closed, as on Windows. Waiters no longer block forever.
- Persona 5 Royal: fixed crashes with Reloaded-II mods ([#873](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/873)).
- The Last of Us Part II: daily-run leaderboards work again ([#463](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/463)).
- NCSOFT PURPLE launcher ([#870](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/870)):
  - Runs in WoW64 mode.
  - No longer stays closed after restarting itself for an update, which fixes `cmd /C choice /T` timeouts.
- EA app: fixed installs failing with INST-14-1603. New prefixes include the Wine Mono support package again ([#857](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/857), [#881](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/881)).
- Prefixes moved from Valve's Proton to GE-Proton no longer fail .NET 4.0 and 4.8 installs. Leftover read-only links to the other install are replaced.
- Prefix upgrades:
  - Prefix upgrade and downgrade logic runs again ([#900](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/900)).
  - The prefix version now follows Valve's (`11.0-100`). The log shows the GE build name.
- 32-bit OpenXR applications are now supported ([#906](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/906)).
- Liarsoft games (codeX RScript): reduced audio crackling. The high-quality resampler is kept for any number of sound buffers ([#521](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/521)).
- Fixed WoW64 processes crashing on exit with the Wayland driver.
- The compatibility report template now asks for Wine-Wayland and launcher details, and suggests `PROTON_LOG` channel presets for common problem areas.
- Release workflow: an already uploaded release build is never replaced.

# GE-Proton11-11

Hotfix Release

Changes since GE-Proton11-10.

## Video Playback

- Fixed games freezing when a video is skipped or closed while MPEG-1 audio is playing through
DirectShow (deadlock in the MPEG audio decoder, a regression since GE-Proton11-8)
([#865](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/865)).
- Fixed MPEG-1 videos played through AMStream showing upside down (a regression since GE-Proton11-1)
([#863](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/863)).
- Fixed heap corruption and crashes from video frames that are converted or scaled, e.g. Target Bravo:
Operation G.H.O.S.T. crashing when entering stage select
([#864](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/pull/864), thanks @aderumier).

## Rendering and HDR

- Fixed Easy Anti-Cheat kicking Star Citizen with "Violation 8 - Untrusted system file"
(`StarCitizen_Launcher.exe`, error 30033) since GE-Proton11-7. The same issue affects Hunt: Showdown
(`hunt.exe`) when launched outside Steam. VKD3D-Proton no longer reads the parent process's executable
to detect Unreal Engine games ([#858](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/858),
[vkd3d-proton#3348](https://github.com/HansKristian-Work/vkd3d-proton/issues/3348)).
- Removed the Star Citizen native AMD AGS override added in GE-Proton11-10. It was not the cause of the
EAC violation.
- Space Marine 2 was also reported broken in 11-10, but worked when tested with the above mentioned changes.

## Protonfixes

- Star Citizen: install .NET 4.8 for the new RSI Launcher.
- Windows version fixes (`win10`, `win7`, etc.) are now re-applied when a later winetricks install
changes the Windows version. Previously a failed or partial .NET install could leave a prefix on
Windows XP.
- Added fixes for the BepInEx, MelonLoader and FrostyModManager mod loaders.
- Call of Duty (2003): fixed the game fix not running.
- Ceville: respect `PROTON_USE_XALIA` if it is already set.
- Removed the unused `amdxcffx64` winetricks verb and updated the umu database.

name: GE-Proton11-10 Released
body:
## Component Updates

- Wine: Valve bleeding-edge 2026-10-16. This brings upstream syscall emulation through Syscall User Dispatch and native-syscall handling for EAC (EOS) launchers. Also included: Xalia now shuts down cleanly, fewer spurious X11 mouse movement events, a Witcher 3 controller rescan fix, and a ddraw fix for paletted primary surfaces.
- Wine: `PROTON_LIMIT_ADDRESS_SPACE` and its address-space limits for Reverse: 1999 and Blue Protocol: Star Resonance were removed upstream.
- DXVK: v3.1.1-134. Includes D3D9 texture, StretchRect and device-reset fixes, D3D8 CopyRects rework, a workaround for an EA anti-cheat code-signing crash, shader cache fixes, and zero-initialized shader scratch memory for Call of Duty: Ghosts.
- D7VK: rebased onto DXVK v3.1.1.
- VKD3D-Proton: fixes synchronization around queued transfer operations.
- FEX: FEX-2610-30.

## Controllers

- The automatic PlayStation controller XInput fallback no longer rescans every HID device each time a game polls an empty controller slot. Since GE-Proton11-8 this caused large slowdowns, even with no controller connected:
  - Path of Exile ran at ~50 FPS instead of 200+ ([#862](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/862)).
  - Le Mans Ultimate slow-motion physics with a Moza wheel ([#777](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/777)).
  - Story of Seasons: Friends of Mineral Town lost FPS with `PROTON_PREFER_SDL` ([#850](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/850)).
  - Setting `PROTON_SONY_AUTO_XINPUT=0` confirmed this was the cause in #862; the fix itself has not been confirmed in-game yet.
- Sackboy: A Big Adventure and Rune Factory 4 Special now default to `PROTON_SONY_AUTO_XINPUT=0`. This fixes the DualSense being assigned to player two in Sackboy and scrambled DS4 input in Rune Factory ([#843](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/843)). The variable was confirmed by two users.
- Bluetooth DualShock 4 and DualSense rumble now works through the XInput fallback, and input no longer stops after the first rumble ([#853](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/pull/854), thanks @ilyasbounoua). Native hidraw games on Bluetooth keep the extended controller reports (gyro and touchpad).
- `PROTON_SONY_HIDRAW_XINPUT`, `PROTON_SONY_AUTO_XINPUT`, `PROTON_DUALSENSE_HAPTICS_PREFER_NON_EVENT` and `PROTON_DEATH_STRANDING_CONTROLLER_EFFECTS` now reach the HID bus driver; previously the driver ignored them.

## Wayland and Windowing

- GNOME: fixed games and launchers closing when a window that owns a popup is destroyed (mutter: "destroyed popup not top most popup"). This affected AION 2 and Battle.net auto-login with `PROTON_ENABLE_WAYLAND=1` ([#834](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/834)). Not yet confirmed on GNOME.

## Video Playback

- MonoGame games no longer stall or crash when a song is played again, for example Picross for a Cause ([#839](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/pull/839), thanks @Petru101).

## Rendering and HDR

- KDE Plasma: HDR detection now uses KWin's per-monitor HDR state. HDR monitors are detected even when SDR brightness is set to the HDR reference level. Other compositors keep the existing detection ([#838](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/838)).

## Other Changes

- Arknights: Endfield: added the ACE anti-cheat driver fixes from dwproton ([#847](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/847)):
  - DriverEntry is called with a kernel-mode return address.
  - ntoskrnl fixes: `MmCopyMemory`, `ServiceKeyName`, MDL section views and `PsGetContextThread`.
  - A stub `lsass.exe` (SamSs) service is added and started.
  - This matches dwproton. The remaining ACE bugcheck `0x65636154` is still unresolved there too.
- Star Citizen: loads the game's bundled AMD AGS library again, as GE-Proton11-6 did. This should avoid the EAC "Untrusted system file" violation and error 30033 ([#858](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/858)). Not yet confirmed in-game.
- Faster shared SRW lock releases. Lock-heavy games spend less time in ntdll; Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 went from 24.5% to 19.1% ([#844](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/pull/844), thanks @smatkovi).
- Build: clang/libc++ and llvm-libc build fixes ([#835](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/pull/835), thanks @FireBurn).

name: GE-Proton11-9 Released
body:
# Hotfix release:

# GE-Proton11-9

  ## Video Playback
  - Added a fix for Crimson Desert getting stuck after selecting Play or starting a new game due to
  looping menu-video playback. Affects both Wine-Wayland and XWayland.

  ## Rendering and HDR
  - Added automatic HDR detection for DX11/DXVK and DX12/VKD3D-Proton with Wine-Wayland or Gamescope.
  - `PROTON_ENABLE_HDR=1` and `PROTON_USE_HDR=1` are no longer required. HDR must still be enabled in
  the desktop or Gamescope.
  - Corrected a Wine-Wayland detection regression that incorrectly reported HDR displays as SDR,
  affecting Dragon's Dogma 2 and other games on compositors without optional Windows-specific color-
  management extensions.
  - Preserved SDR fallback when HDR is unavailable or disabled.
  - Retained legacy HDR overrides. Use `DXVK_NO_HDR=1` to disable HDR reporting.
  - Updated the README with automatic HDR setup instructions.

# Pre-hotfix changelog:

# GE-Proton11-8

  Changes since GE-Proton11-7.

  ## Component Updates
  - Updated Wine bleeding-edge, DXVK, VKD3D-Proton, VKD3D, D7VK, DXVK-NVAPI, DXVK-IGDext, FEX,
  lsteamclient, wineopenxr and protonfixes.
  - Rebased the downstream patch stack and removed patches superseded upstream.

  ## Controllers
  - Added automatic PlayStation-to-XInput fallback when Steam Input is disabled, including
  appropriate controller identity and button origins for supported games. Native controller
  handling and real Steam Input take priority.
  - Removed most (now obsolete) game-specific Sony fallback overrides; improved compatibility with Grandia I/
  II, Lunar, Sky, God of War Ragnarok and Horizon Zero Dawn.
  - Fixed Diablo IV's startup DualSense detection and added DualSense Edge compatibility.
  - Fixed Castlevania Anniversary Collection controller replacement and late connection.
  - Improved DS4 speaker audio, Sony controller hotplugging, Death Stranding speaker switching
  and Monster Hunter Wilds haptics. Addressed audio initialization races and expensive
  controller polling.
  - Added Switch Pro/compatible controller XInput support and corrected Dynasty Warriors 8
  DualSense mappings.

  ## Steam Overlay
  - Fixed Guide-button overlay not closing under Wine-Wayland, including Labwc and Warframe.
  - Improved overlay cursor ownership and visibility; fixed a Wine-Wayland clipboard-related
  World of Warcraft crash.

  ## Wayland and Windowing
  - Fixed fullscreen Alt+Tab restoration in Guild Wars Reforged
  - Fixed startup/minimize recovery for Deadlock on Niri. Added cross-driver suppression of the 
  transient minimized-window white rectangle. ([#781](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/781), [#762]
  (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/762))
  - Improved Battle.net tray-menu rendering, positioning, keyboard focus, cursor handling and
  tray recovery.
  - Fixed Warframe's missing launcher settings dialog and disappearing cursor.
  - Fixed Touhou 11's unwanted fixed-window resizing 
  - Fixed Zenless Zone Zero launcher window being mistaken for a tray menu.
  - Improved GNOME direct-scanout compatibility, Vulkan surface opacity metadata and cursor
  confinement updates.
  - Preserved Assassin's Creed DX10 fullscreen mode across Alt+Tab.

  ## Video Playback
  - Improved VRChat YouTube, HTTP MP4, HLS, MPEG-TS and RTSP playback, including URL
  compatibility, playlists, seeking, pause/resume, audio synchronization and periodic
  streaming stalls.
  - Enabled AV1 decoding through dav1d.
  - Fixed Resident Evil 4 video corruption and improved intro playback performance
  - Fixed WUCHANG skill-preview videos. ([#775](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/
  issues/775), [#787](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/787))
  - Added playback fixes for Borderlands 3, Saku Saku, Fairy Fencer F Advent Dark Force,
  SHUFFLE! Essence+, Hatsumira, Colin McRae Rally 3 and One Piece: Pirate Warriors 4.
  - Fixed interrupted music in T4C Neerya and an audio-sample memory leak affecting Apple
  Jack.
  - Fixed Way of the Samurai 4 movie-skipping crashes.
  - Improved King of Fighters XIII and Taito Type X2 movie compatibility, added DirectDraw
  video-overlay emulation, and fixed a seeking deadlock affecting SNK Heroines.

  ## Rendering and HDR
  - Added reported-working StarCraft II GPU-hang workaround. ([#790](https://github.com/
  GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/790))
  - Fixed Meridian: New World's dark lighting and scrolling flicker through Wine-Mono/FNA
  stencil-state fixes.
  - Fixed Le Mans Ultimate initialization and HUD/text rendering through Direct2D
  improvements. ([#777](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/777))
  - Enabled Warframe's DX11 HDR detection and added SDR fallback when HDR is requested but
  unavailable on the output.

  ## Protonfixes
  - Project Torque: corrected .NET dependencies and disabled Xalia to prevent startup
  problems.
  - The Witcher 3: hid Wine exports to restore graphics features disabled by the game's Wine
  detection.
  - Added or updated fixes for A Way Out, Way of the Samurai 4, Ceville, Kanvas Launcher and
  the original Call of Duty's non-Steam release.
  - Updated the UMU database and fixed the unzip dependency URL.

  ## Other Changes
  - Added opt-in Bluetooth LE support for applications such as Zwift and Rouvy using
  `PROTON_ENABLE_WINEBTH=1`.
  - Fixed unsafe timing-source selection, process-exit hangs, Richard Burns Rally's exit
  crash, and serial-port probing that disrupted Sinden lightguns.
  - Added SHA-256 certificate-property support for MTA and corrected incomplete TLS-record
  handling.
  - Restored ARM64 DXVK-NVAPI builds, enabled FEX disk caching by default, and updated
  upstream game/launcher compatibility fixes.
  - Expanded controller documentation and replaced obsolete RDNA3-specific FSR4 guidance with
  `PROTON_FSR4_UPGRADE`.

  handling and real Steam Input take priority.
  - Removed most (now obsolete) game-specific Sony fallback overrides; improved compatibility with Grandia I/
  II, Lunar, Sky, God of War Ragnarok and Horizon Zero Dawn.
  - Fixed Diablo IV's startup DualSense detection and added DualSense Edge compatibility.
  - Fixed Castlevania Anniversary Collection controller replacement and late connection.
  - Improved DS4 speaker audio, Sony controller hotplugging, Death Stranding speaker switching
  and Monster Hunter Wilds haptics. Addressed audio initialization races and expensive
  controller polling.
  - Added Switch Pro/compatible controller XInput support and corrected Dynasty Warriors 8
  DualSense mappings.

  ## Steam Overlay
  - Fixed Guide-button overlay not closing under Wine-Wayland, including Labwc and Warframe.
  - Improved overlay cursor ownership and visibility; fixed a Wine-Wayland clipboard-related
  World of Warcraft crash.

  ## Wayland and Windowing
  - Fixed fullscreen Alt+Tab restoration in Guild Wars Reforged
  - Fixed startup/minimize recovery for Deadlock on Niri. Added cross-driver suppression of the 
  transient minimized-window white rectangle. ([#781](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/781), [#762]
  (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/762))
  - Improved Battle.net tray-menu rendering, positioning, keyboard focus, cursor handling and
  tray recovery.
  - Fixed Warframe's missing launcher settings dialog and disappearing cursor.
  - Fixed Touhou 11's unwanted fixed-window resizing 
  - Fixed Zenless Zone Zero launcher window being mistaken for a tray menu.
  - Improved GNOME direct-scanout compatibility, Vulkan surface opacity metadata and cursor
  confinement updates.
  - Preserved Assassin's Creed DX10 fullscreen mode across Alt+Tab.

  ## Video Playback
  - Improved VRChat YouTube, HTTP MP4, HLS, MPEG-TS and RTSP playback, including URL
  compatibility, playlists, seeking, pause/resume, audio synchronization and periodic
  streaming stalls.
  - Enabled AV1 decoding through dav1d.
  - Fixed Resident Evil 4 video corruption and improved intro playback performance
  - Fixed WUCHANG skill-preview videos. ([#775](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/
  issues/775), [#787](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/787))
  - Added playback fixes for Borderlands 3, Saku Saku, Fairy Fencer F Advent Dark Force,
  SHUFFLE! Essence+, Hatsumira, Colin McRae Rally 3 and One Piece: Pirate Warriors 4.
  - Fixed interrupted music in T4C Neerya and an audio-sample memory leak affecting Apple
  Jack.
  - Fixed Way of the Samurai 4 movie-skipping crashes.
  - Improved King of Fighters XIII and Taito Type X2 movie compatibility, added DirectDraw
  video-overlay emulation, and fixed a seeking deadlock affecting SNK Heroines.

  ## Rendering and HDR
  - Added reported-working StarCraft II GPU-hang workaround. ([#790](https://github.com/
  GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/790))
  - Fixed Meridian: New World's dark lighting and scrolling flicker through Wine-Mono/FNA
  stencil-state fixes.
  - Fixed Le Mans Ultimate initialization and HUD/text rendering through Direct2D
  improvements. ([#777](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/777))
  - Enabled Warframe's DX11 HDR detection and added SDR fallback when HDR is requested but
  unavailable on the output.

  ## Protonfixes
  - Project Torque: corrected .NET dependencies and disabled Xalia to prevent startup
  problems.
  - The Witcher 3: hid Wine exports to restore graphics features disabled by the game's Wine
  detection.
  - Added or updated fixes for A Way Out, Way of the Samurai 4, Ceville, Kanvas Launcher and
  the original Call of Duty's non-Steam release.
  - Updated the UMU database and fixed the unzip dependency URL.

  ## Other Changes
  - Added opt-in Bluetooth LE support for applications such as Zwift and Rouvy using
  `PROTON_ENABLE_WINEBTH=1`.
  - Fixed unsafe timing-source selection, process-exit hangs, Richard Burns Rally's exit
  crash, and serial-port probing that disrupted Sinden lightguns.
  - Added SHA-256 certificate-property support for MTA and corrected incomplete TLS-record
  handling.
  - Restored ARM64 DXVK-NVAPI builds, enabled FEX disk caching by default, and updated
  upstream game/launcher compatibility fixes.
  - Expanded controller documentation and replaced obsolete RDNA3-specific FSR4 guidance with
  `PROTON_FSR4_UPGRADE`.

name: GE-Proton11-7 Released
body:
## 1. Wine-Wayland Child-Process Rendering

### Expanded and Rebased Wine-Wineland Integration

Imported additional cross-process DMA-BUF, Vulkan, EGL/OpenGL, and child-window composition fixes from **Erhan Bilgili / nanomatters**, preserving author headers and source references. This extends the child-process rendering already present in 11-6; it is not its initial introduction.

The additions cover producer/consumer lifecycle management, attachment and replacement ordering, presentation geometry, linear DMA-BUF fallback, configure completion, popup handling, minimized/hidden windows, and toplevel sizing. The resulting child-rendering series contains 85 numbered patches, including GE follow-ups and adaptations from other authors. [Import/rebase commit](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/45ec34f4), [source and integration notes](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/blob/GE-Proton11-7/patches/wine-hotfixes/wineland-child-rendering/README.md).

Specific EGL fixes retire stale frame callbacks after detach/reattach, defer ordinary swaps without a live toplevel, avoid applying both native EGL throttling and Wine's manual throttling, recreate EGL surfaces after role transitions, and supply a fallback context when applications release their WGL context before `SwapBuffers`. The fallback-context adaptation credits **Paul Gofman**.

### Purple Launcher and Embedded Games

- **NCSOFT Purple navigation/render stalls:** fixed the class of failures where login or game-selection content appeared only after maximizing, restoring, or moving the window. The final work coordinates native presenters per HWND, retires background Vulkan probe presenters locally, and preserves GDI content over native rendering. This avoids letting an unrelated probe take over or stall the actual display surface. Earlier unsuccessful iterations were superseded. [Final rendering fix](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/b4f64ae9), [preceding integration](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/6bf1e672). The user confirmed the launcher-rendering fix.
- **Lineage II game running without a visible window:** added presenter coordination and changed the Wayland event dispatcher to use a system-thread lifecycle. System-thread support includes work credited to **Alexandre Julliard** and **M0n7y5**, with GE integration and follow-ups. [Commit](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/6bc30234). Later fixes ensure system threads do not keep a process alive after its last user thread exits.
- **Forza Horizon 5 login and black-screen failures:** restored the cross-process rendering path needed by its WebView2 login UI, kept unwanted background windows unmapped on wlroots/X11, and added cross-process selected-cursor handling for child login windows. The old FH5 `noopwr` exception was removed. [Commit](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/16a62e92), [issue #459](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/459). The session confirmed the menu and login window displaying; the commit also addresses the subsequently reported missing cursor.
- **Marvel Rivals launcher flicker:** DXVK now retains its swapchain and last frame on transient `VK_NOT_READY` / `VK_TIMEOUT`, retrying on a later acquire rather than continually recreating the swapchain. This accommodates the managed child producer's nonblocking backpressure. It also fixes fresh-swapchain pending-state and fence bookkeeping. [Commit](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/433e61b8). **Included, but the patch notes still require runtime retesting.**

### Black Screens, Workspaces, and Surface Lifetime

- Fixed opaque child surfaces being obscured by their backing windows, distinguished actual GDI overlays from backing SHM, and corrected opaque-content geometry classification. This addresses Hyprland black screens and the related workspace-following behavior. [Initial fix](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/2ffdc134), [workspace fix](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/6816728c), [follow-up](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/aac9f925), [issue #725](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/725). The issue includes later NVIDIA/Hyprland confirmation, not just AMD reports.
- Improved opaque carrier surfaces to permit direct scanout. [Issue #734](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/734) contains positive testing in Dead by Daylight and Lethal Company, but also a subsequent disappearing-window report. Do not describe every direct-scanout configuration as conclusively verified.
- Fixed output-removal locking/lifetime behavior that could deadlock the event thread after a monitor power cycle. [Commit](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/53ed6068), [issue #731](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/731).
- Removed user-lock/surface-update inversions, recovered presentation after surface transitions, and prevented background or replacement swapchains from prematurely destroying the selected presentation owner. These changes are shared infrastructure, not launcher-specific environment-variable workarounds.

## 2. Windowed, Fullscreen, Resize, and Cursor Fixes

| Game / behavior | Change and references |
| --- | --- |
| **Black Desert Online** | Multiple fixes for fullscreen, borderless, windowed transitions, transient hiding, sizing, and focus-loss behavior. The final focus-loss work includes DXVK and Wine game-specific handling; the generic DXGI option alone did not solve BDO. [#721](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/721), [e99a95ca](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/e99a95ca), [93a5b551](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/93a5b551), [682c0499](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/682c0499), [db69568d](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/db69568d). |
| **Final Fantasy XIV** | Preserve fullscreen on focus loss instead of shrinking the game to its lower render resolution when clicking another monitor or Alt+Tabbing. Added DXGI `dxgi.keepFullscreenOnFocusLoss` behavior and appropriate compatibility handling. [#639](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/639), [db69568d](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/db69568d). |
| **Lineage II** | Corrected tiny/titlebar-only windows and fullscreen/windowed transitions, including Wayland's invisible-fullscreen failure. DXVK defers initial fullscreen for probe swapchains so launcher graphics probes do not resize/activate the wrong window. [d442b416](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/d442b416). |
| **Lineage II splash and exit** | Clean up windows belonging to terminated threads so the splash closes; prevent waiting indefinitely on contended SRW locks during process exit so the game does not remain running. User confirmed both fixes. [8e700a08](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/8e700a08), [663d91c6](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/663d91c6). |
| **Aion** | Correct native resize/maximize notifications and presentation sizing, fixing drag-resize cursor mismatch and black rendering. Follow-up uses surface-local coordinates for pointer warps, fixing right-button camera movement resetting toward a top-down view. User confirmed resize and camera fixes. [80365ed3](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/80365ed3). |
| **Civilization VI / D3D12** | Follow fullscreen client resizes in DXGI so mouse coordinates track resolution changes rather than retaining the previous fullscreen geometry. Reported on both XWayland and Wayland. [f9d23919](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/f9d23919). |
| **Dragon Age: Inquisition** | Correct thin-border fullscreen geometry to remove the offset white border around the borderless window. [#570](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/570), [8eaaed67](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/8eaaed67). |
| **Painkiller Black Edition** | Refresh the D3D9 device-window handle on reset, fixing a tiny game window inside a black rectangle. Initially carried locally, then removed because the updated DXVK includes the fix. [#579](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/579), [initial patch](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/4bfa5a97), [local patch removal](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/a8c3f806). Upstream implementation: **WinterSnowfall**, [DXVK 6bc6d9ec](https://github.com/doitsujin/dxvk/commit/6bc6d9ec). |

## 3. DS5 / DualSense and Other Controller Fixes

- **New Sony-to-XInput game defaults:** Capcom Fighting Collection, Capcom Fighting Collection 2, MARVEL vs. CAPCOM Fighting Collection: Arcade Classics, Street Fighter 30th Anniversary Collection, and Tetris Effect: Connected. **btegs**, [PR #726](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/pull/726), [merge](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/27c6b8d3). Tetris's earlier DS4-spoof change was superseded by the final XInput setting.
- **eFootball:** enable the Sony HIDRAW XInput compatibility path for DS4/DS5. [5991b9be](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/5991b9be), [#756](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/756).
- **Dragon Age: Inquisition:** enable the same XInput path and remove the older game patch it replaces. [57cfd72c](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/57cfd72c).
- **Grandia, Grandia II, and Lunar:** replace DS4 identity-generation spoofing with Sony XInput plus the Steam Input fallback. [cb77b502](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/cb77b502).
- **VitaPad:** wired VitaPad is exposed as a DS4 by default, not through a new opt-in. Translate its actual seven-byte input report, including sticks, face buttons, D-pad, digital triggers, and rear-touch button mappings. Unsupported rumble/gyro/touch features are not invented. Requires host HIDRAW access; the distributed VitaPad v2.0.0 protocol is the supported mapping. [197f299d](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/197f299d), [#691](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/691). Protocol credit: **carlelieser**, with mapping corroboration from **deadbeef7**.
- Rebased the existing Sony audio/haptics/hotplug stack against current Wine, retaining behavior and removing an overlapping hotplug patch already supplied upstream. [2bad9078](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/2bad9078), [rebase notes](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/blob/GE-Proton11-7/patches/wine-hotfixes/wine-wayland/README.md).

## 4. Video Playback Fixes

| Area | Fix, attribution, and tracking |
| --- | --- |
| **Source Reader premature EOF** | Drain Media Foundation transforms on demand before reporting end-of-stream; retain buffered output and respect downstream backpressure, including final WMA samples. Patch author **atty303**, integrated and subsequently rebased by GE. [35b03da1](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/35b03da1), [#719](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/719). |
| **Grandia II resurrection freeze** | Preserve natural presentation completion and serialize a replay request against the previous presentation's sink/source drain. This fixes a successful-but-no-op replay at EOF after the resurrection clip, rather than adding a game timer or skipping the movie. [cb77b502](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/cb77b502), [#739](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/739). |
| **The Witch's Love Diary opening** | Implement Quartz's RGB Color Space Converter and allow QASF to negotiate compressed ASF audio/video with downstream WMA/WMV decoder DMOs. Includes format validation and regression coverage; decoded formats remain preferred for existing automatic graphs. [3f1fa725](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/3f1fa725), [#755](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/755). |
| **Call of Duty: Black Ops III cutscenes** | Negotiate coded H.264 NV12 dimensions consistently, including 1920x1088 backing storage for a 1920x1080 visible frame. Corrects chroma offsets/sample lengths implicated in the green strip and corrupted picture, while preserving the visible aperture. [4459c577](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/4459c577), [#771](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/771). |
| **Media stack maintenance** | Rebase the existing FFmpeg/winedmo, Media Foundation, DirectShow, audio, and HLS work against updated Wine without reinstating Wine-GStreamer. [aab64e71](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/aab64e71). |

## 5. Steam Overlay

- **Cursor restoration after closing:** refresh the game's cursor state when leaving the overlay instead of leaving an unwanted desktop cursor over gameplay until an Alt+Tab. Reproduced with Marvel Rivals. [55957c05](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/55957c05), [#724](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/724). The user confirmed it after selecting the correct test build.
- **Fractional-scaling coordinates:** add fractional-scale protocol handling and translate between Wayland logical coordinates and the overlay's pixel coordinates. This fixes the mismatch where the overlay looked scaled correctly but its mouse hit targets still behaved as though the desktop were unscaled 2160p. [8ba3d8e9](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/8ba3d8e9), [#717](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/717); #728 was a duplicate.
- **Focus restoration and Steam Input identity:** use a separate root-level X11 `InputOnly` focus window instead of focusing the renderer's `InputOutput` drawable, which could cause Mutter to deactivate the native Wayland game. On seats with a keyboard, keyboard focus now governs bridge focus rather than mouse hover keeping an inactive game marked focused. Shared by the Vulkan and native EGL paths. [fb769bc5](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/fb769bc5), [#754](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/754).
- **VRR and flickering:** retain the presentation owner between swapchains rather than tearing it down during transient replacements. This complements the focus fix. [cf707135](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/cf707135), [#753](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/753), [#754](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/754). Both discussions contain successful retests, including after the component rebase.
- **Related layered-overlay fix, not exclusively Steam:** make `WINE_LAYERED_OVERLAY_INPUT_SHAPE=0` genuinely click-through for transparent ALPHA-mode windows rather than leaving a full-window input sink. SHAPE mode is unchanged. **Thaylor Santos / thaylorz**, [PR #760](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/pull/760), [d6a21ffd](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/d6a21ffd); addresses symptoms reported in [#752](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/752).
- **Screenshot/focus crash report:** #749's null-output-pointer Wayland window-state callback fault was identified as covered by the earlier state-update fix, [2ffdc134](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/2ffdc134). The report also contained `VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST`; closing it does not prove every possible screenshot-related GPU fault fixed. [#749](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/749).

## 6. Protonfixes and UMU Database

| Change | Author | Commit / merged PR |
| --- | --- | --- |

Use native,builtin only when a game-local DSfix `dinput8.dll` actually exists; otherwise prefer builtin, including repairing the saved override. Resolves the confirmed cause of [GE #737](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/737). | GloriousEggroll | [19cbf11](https://github.com/Open-Wine-Components/umu-protonfixes/commit/19cbf11), direct commit. |

| **procps-ng subproject:** `66b48a3` to `9b60249`. | dependabot | [PR #633](https://github.com/Open-Wine-Components/umu-protonfixes/pull/633), [merge 070f05e](https://github.com/Open-Wine-Components/umu-protonfixes/commit/070f05e). |

## 7. Additional Fixes and Integration

### Mono, Launchers, Authentication, and Installers

- **Purple without Winetricks .NET 4.8:** teach Mono to distinguish explicit zero FieldRVA entries from missing field data and preserve by-reference TypeSpec signatures in reflection. Add Wine's missing SQM machine identifier while ensuring fresh prefixes receive distinct values. These address separate startup exceptions rather than suppressing them. [e5d50b87](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/e5d50b87). Wine-Mono preparation/build integration now extracts a clean source tree, applies patches, and rebuilds the affected runtimes; cached source archives are reused without a checksum pass, as requested. Historical README validation notes are not a claim that every WPF feature is supported.
- **SP Football Life / eFootball Settings.exe:** resolve unspecified icon dimensions before choosing an icon frame, avoiding `System.Drawing.Icon` selecting a malformed large frame and aborting startup. Rebuild and package the affected `System.Drawing` class library. [9acec1ec](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/9acec1ec), [build integration](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/3d6a8897), [#675](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/675). The patch includes regression fixtures; the source notes do not establish a completed end-to-end runtime test for every Settings.exe variant.
- **Purple authentication / SWTOR launcher and installer:** correct PFX machine-keyset/provider information, choose the actual container key spec, reject unsupported NCRYPT-only private-key acquisition, and pump thread user messages during synchronous URLMon binding. Restore these patches to prep after they were accidentally omitted during a rebase. [f4f8507c](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/f4f8507c), [dde9418a](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/dde9418a), [f0c72c6e](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/f0c72c6e), [#722](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/722).
- **VC++ 2005/2008 runtime installation:** make the relevant WinSxS runtime DLLs replaceable instead of leaving them as read-only linked files. Addresses `vcrun2008` installation, not an unsupported claim that every redistributable problem has the same cause. [152c53f5](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/152c53f5), [#705](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/705).
- **Warcraft III: Reforged authentication:** support modern and legacy `CERT_CHAIN_ENGINE_CONFIG` layouts without dropping existing exclusive-root semantics. Addresses the misleading "check your VPN" login error. **Stathis Papadopoulos / Statharas**, [PR #765](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/pull/765), [507af3e4](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/507af3e4), [#763](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/763). Backports credit **Hans Leidekker** and **Yuxuan Shui**; the additional compatibility/test patch records **Codex** as its author. The submitted PR's documentation reports a completed build, ABI probes, trust-regression checks, and successful user authentication; those were not rerun for this summary.

### Game Compatibility and Stability

- **Diablo IV periodic freezes:** refresh cached power status asynchronously so battery monitoring cannot repeatedly block game threads. [421391b7](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/421391b7).
- **Hades native Vulkan:** restrict the extra-swapchain-image workaround to DOOM, then use supported per-present-mode three-image capabilities on Wayland instead of incompatible legacy limits. [798d767f](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/798d767f), [2e7dfa89](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/2e7dfa89).
- **Path of Exile / Path of Exile 2 native Vulkan:** extend that gated three-image compatibility path to avoid the startup "unsupported backbuffer image count" failure. Uses actual host capabilities, excludes DXVK/VKD3D instances, and does not hide real swapchain images. [d8522c3c](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/d8522c3c).
- **DOOM Eternal HDR flicker:** allow safe reuse of an idle cached Vulkan client surface even while the application retains references to old VkSurfaces. Keep the attachment stable unless the actual role/parent changes, preserving DMA-BUF feedback and avoiding repeated surface replacement. Retain isolation for other applications' probe surfaces. [1c5199e7](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/1c5199e7), adapting **Etaash Mathamsetty's** caching work. The patch explicitly calls for runtime retesting.
- **Forza Horizon 6 startup:** keep builtin `amd_ags_x64` selection ahead of the native-version heuristic. [910e88f7](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/910e88f7), [d80450dc](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/d80450dc), [#730](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/730). Its child-window black-screen work is covered above.
- **The Witcher 3 DX12 startup:** temporarily patched the VKD3D-Proton optimized raw-buffer UAV clear regression, then removed the local patch after updating to an upstream fixed version. [62fce828](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/62fce828), [removal 145bfdee](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/145bfdee), [#720](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/720).
- **AI LIMIT DX12 black screen:** narrowly scoped compatibility handling lets the inspected UnityPlayer build reuse existing DXBC compute variants when the game has no DX12 variant. Keeps the DX12 device and does not modify installed game files; unknown module versions are left untouched. [12450e41](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/12450e41), [#736](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/736). Rendering restoration was demonstrated during diagnosis; the Wine-hook patch itself notes further validation with original assets.
- **Max Payne new-game crash:** add CPU-detection compatibility handling. [f44cb95e](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/f44cb95e). Distinct from the already-upstreamed intro-video issue [#607](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/607).
- **Return to Krondor text:** correct text bitmap readback. [072d46e7](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/072d46e7), [#587](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/587). Its intro-video fix was June's `658ac276`, before this range.
- **NASCAR 25:** add compatibility changes for the updated game's startup/protector failure. **619 Motorsports**, [3333403d](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/3333403d), [PR #747](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/pull/747).
- **Space Marine 2 EAC startup:** recognize EOS/EAC launcher executable names properly. [c678c99d](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/c678c99d), related [#740](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/740). This is launcher compatibility, not disabling anti-cheat.

### General Wine, Input, and Launcher Behavior

- **Clipboard:** backport **Aaron Yourk's** OLE32 stale-handle fix and tests, addressing long-standing copy/paste failures including Space Engineers. [7d669f75](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/7d669f75), [GE #531](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/531), [Wine MR !10889](https://gitlab.winehq.org/wine/wine/-/merge_requests/10889).
- **Wayland keyboard layout:** follow the compositor-provided keymap rather than using an incorrect inferred layout. Reporter confirmed the fix with Wayland enabled. [1e1016bf](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/1e1016bf), [#309](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/309).
- **UMU / lsteamclient:** disable `lsteamclient` for UMU launches unless `UMU_USE_STEAM=1` is explicitly set; correct the earlier inverted behavior. [facd70e7](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/facd70e7). Also return a normal initialization failure if native steamclient cannot be loaded rather than asserting, including affected Faugus/Winetricks prefix-creation paths. [7e719edb](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/7e719edb), reported separately in the [#721 discussion](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/721#issuecomment-5636768298).
- **QueryPerformanceCounter:** add a user-mode TSC fast path. **Haeris31**, [PR #759](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/pull/759), [d3642203](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/d3642203). GE's [7a3a89fe](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/7a3a89fe) excludes ARM64EC from x86-only code, fixing the reported ARM build failure. Do not generalize an individual benchmark to all games.
- **Serial devices:** implement `IOCTL_SERIAL_GET_DTRRTS`. **Haeris31**, [PR #761](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/pull/761), [077ee215](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/077ee215).
- **Low-latency layer packaging:** use a relative library path, integrate reset/patch preparation, and document `LOW_LATENCY_LAYER`. **Tariq Alashaikh / sleepytariq**, [PR #742](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/pull/742), [PR #758](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/pull/758).

### Rebase and Upstream Proton Integration

Updated Wine bleeding-edge and rebased EM-11, child rendering, video, controller, staging, game, Steam client, WineOpenXR, and OptiScaler patches. New EM-11 imports include output enter/leave positioning, image-description lifetime/color handling, size hints, wl_output v4, activation tokens, owner hints, and Vulkan structure-generation corrections. [5b5dd445](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/5b5dd445), [integration notes](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/blob/GE-Proton11-7/patches/wine-hotfixes/wine-wayland/README.md).

body:
Wine-Wayland Changes

  - Updated the Wine bleeding-edge base twice and imported/rebased the latest EM11 Wine-Wayland series: 3e5f91eb
    (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/3e5f91eb114f17d81eef001d3bcee0e69243bb00), 0c63e181
    (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/0c63e18158bb5316c2b7eec210b7c85157870920), 061e2df3
    (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/061e2df331dc1e035ecc62d0ea5ad0aec90ee6e1), 09b1a374
    (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/09b1a3747e3f6ad0b32d6de676a1aa1c804fe237). Original EM11/Wine authorship remains preserved in each patch.

  - Imported Wine-Wineland’s 58-patch cross-process DMA-BUF child-rendering series in eb556a34
    (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/eb556a3470b02a8c2745abf167dd0601a8d3e89a). This covers GDI, OpenGL and Vulkan child windows, CEF launchers, popups, menus,
    clipping, shaped windows, frame throttling and producer lifecycle.

  - That series is primarily by Erhan Bilgili (nanomatters). It includes a present-wait follow-up by Etaash Mathamsetty, a fallback-context change based on work by Paul Gofman, and final
    integration fixes by Thomas Crider (GloriousEggroll).

  - Added StatusNotifierItem tray icons and native context menus from Erhan Bilgili, plus host desktop notifications and edge placement: f6424475
    (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/f64244754aa0c0e1830f046282b9a098617e1289), with corrected credit in 4334eeec
    (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/4334eeeca8fb44d4850320d70a99c41285f0a802).

  - Enabled simultaneous availability of winewayland.drv and winex11.drv, selected per process through WINE_GRAPHICS_DRIVER. Added PROTON_USE_X11_EXCLUSIVE for user-selected X11 executables.
    Native child rendering later superseded the broad launcher fallback and removed obsolete --in-process-gpu workarounds in 326b36f3
    (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/326b36f3b422a3e145c2fb602c4cddbf2f97d053).

  - Fixed unsupported DDB cursor conversion and Steam desktop virtual-controller filtering in 0a9c71a0
    (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/0a9c71a0635b4ce9c84e1c630bacfc620554093b).

  - Removed a redundant packed-code split lock that delayed Ubisoft Connect startup by minutes: 80261c9d
    (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/80261c9d617391a33eec877b93353db54b933d9e).

  - Closed: #696 Deadlock cursor (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/696) via 0a9c71a0; #706 launcher rendering
    (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/706) via f6424475, subsequently replaced by native child rendering in eb556a34.

  PS5 Controller Changes

  - Reworked DualShock 4, DualSense and DualSense Edge audio/haptic routing, endpoint identity, profile switching and hotplug lifecycle.
  - Added reliable Death Stranding Director’s Cut BB audio, haptics, adaptive triggers and environmental controller effects, then extended the path to Death Stranding 2: deddac88
    (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/deddac88465a7ce94af17bfe2e70718ac040764e), ce9e5f73
    (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/ce9e5f739400e2e1e58d4eec1a58212d2ac45d0c), a8c99cea
    (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/a8c99cea57d2b8181b14a094f9bc4808b6e1fbd6).

  - Fixed controller audio and haptics across Direct/Default profile transitions and prevented Wine from forcing a profile after reconnect: 8acb1f8d
    (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/8acb1f8d3f64062055b5ec78879d5f369892a409), 196d71dc
    (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/196d71dce8e4f82835b27979aff19333a7e071e9) for #697 (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/697).

  - Fixed simultaneous-controller publication and routed speaker effects to the physical controller generating the action: 35298cb1
    (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/35298cb1fd1376ca96430c52d53b965da842dacb), 241ad98c
    (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/241ad98c33281257d8f179754727f7f2addd7680). This closed #702 (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/702).

  - Added DS4-v2-to-DS4-v1 spoofing, including direct DS5/Edge-to-DS4-v1 behavior: 251f376c (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/251f376cc735db513fe1b541f36d772c93ca879f),
    resolving #699 (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/699).

  - Generalized hatswitch and XInput translation based on foriequal0’s #700 proposal (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/700): 0fdd9b74
    (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/0fdd9b74b7fad38fb1c483d74efc738bb02c9e59).

  - Expanded standalone Steam Input fallback support for Horizon Zero Dawn and God of War Ragnarok, including native-Steam-Input gating, controller-profile detection and hotplug updates: 45fd5aff
    (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/45fd5affd90d6c38c860a8f2fad9b27e07fc53fc).

  - Added/fixed presets for Detroit, RDR2, Death Stranding, God of War, HZD, Dune Awakening, Grandia I/II, Lunar, Crash, A Hat in Time, Yakuza 0, Wolfenstein II, Batman Arkham Knight, Little
    Nightmares, Spyro, Greedfall, Dark Souls Remastered, Sekiro, RE Revelations 2, SF6, Monster Hunter Rise and Lightning Returns.

  - Closed: #689 Sekiro (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/689) via 6b00f049
    (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/6b00f049dd6ae94f60b9364fe1557a59a0eaf458); #704 Lightning Returns (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/704)
    via 6efe1e2e (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/6efe1e2ed5ef48d20bfb4c563b439baee5bc4046); #714 Dark Souls Remastered
    (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/714) via bf13e556 (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/bf13e556a1d54c9469b9badfd7ef670301576ff2).

  - Controller preset contributors: Ritaku02 through PR #701 (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/pull/701), and cocsolvi for RDR2 through PR #688
    (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/pull/688).

  Video Rework Changes

  - Added correct MFT drain completion, callbacks outside the sink lock, fragmented Annex-B H.264 assembly, allocator orientation handling and safe allocator shutdown.
  - Fixed #662 Lords of the Fallen (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/662) via 00eb0cc3
    (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/00eb0cc3b697e65574eac6a5d1bb5bd8cf2bef60), #646 Grandia II (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/646) via
    cf9d278e (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/cf9d278eb38f45bc7bb0f6fd89393a55d538526e), #653 Girls’ Frontline 2
    (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/653) via d2e8cc0c (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/d2e8cc0c6bf6af0eda87365cf62d4968b13a4f85), and #606
    Ys: Memories of Celceta (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/606) via e6e49177
    (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/e6e49177273ad6f97e1a7461e85ec51e63328992).

  - Fixed Grandia’s Sult Ruins video through H.264 display-dimension probing and discard-packet handling: 0cec7112
    (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/0cec711257644f796b820bd31d690ec5197cd9de).

  - Added progressive Googlevideo URL handling, live-HLS timestamp/range semantics, autoplay, scrub/pause correction, RGB32 alpha filling, cross-device frame transfer and system-memory live-video
    delivery for VRChat.

  - Final AVPro finite-video and livestream fix closed #682 (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/682): 88af6673
    (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/88af667340f311b380357da1f46bb25e1ec30938). Earlier foundation: db7964a2
    (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/db7964a286f07c9fb9fdfee2d8265c7f931a554c), 966ad8be
    (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/966ad8be364a757dd9ba9c2c88c733e42091c84d).

  - Fixed the serial rtworkq item leak reported in #715 (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/715): 96ff006b
    (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/96ff006b1f55aeac1e678955fcef6cb7b835af9e).

  - #703 Atomic Heart (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/703) and #713 RoboCop (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/713) were closed after
    latest-git validation; GitHub does not record narrower one-to-one commits. Their relevant generic fixes are the fragmented-H.264 work in d2e8cc0c and RGB32-alpha work introduced in db7964a2.

  Overlay Changes

  - Added Steam overlay support under Wine-Wayland, then moved Vulkan interception into a standalone vkroots implicit Vulkan layer: 2f8d3d2c
    (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/2f8d3d2c4489bdd8ae9c4d034b2a7ec52801c01f), 439a9368
    (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/439a9368dec9dbb2735b878de27223ea5332fca8).

  - Removed overlay-specific code from winewayland.drv and moved the shared focus/input bridge into lsteamclient, supporting both native Vulkan and native OpenGL without Zink: 9f394d23
    (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/9f394d2393521155e0109bc5de7e520cd425c75d), f5549ef1
    (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/f5549ef16e1c172585092216c7007de5bf3dee41).

  - Added launcher controller support, mouse capture, relative pointer handling, keyboard/text input, controller navigation, overlay focus, cursor forwarding and suppression of game input while
    the overlay is active.

  - Added OpenGL overlay support under both Wine-X11 and Wine-Wayland: 185681b4 (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/185681b42d9758b572852f7aa66fa186d5e6b1b1), f5549ef1.
  - Fixed overlay text fields and input pass-through, closing #709 (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/709): e9dc5298
    (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/e9dc52989147636daa7827c1a9f80dd893c1bf08).

  - Thaylor Santos moved layered-overlay shape readback off the present path, added MIT-SHM/direct scans and configurable sampling, fixing #712
    (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/issues/712): a21fac45 (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/commit/a21fac45a2d10d98dece7ace8321795a61def861), merged as PR
    #716 (https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/pull/716).

name: GE-Proton11-4 Released
body:
This is AKA the "Controller fixup" release.

First the non-controller related changes:

  Wine And Graphics

  - Updated the Wine base and rebased the GE patch sets.
  - Updated DXVK, DXVK-NVAPI, VKD3D, and VKD3D-Proton.
  - Rebased OptiScaler/upscaler support.
  - Refreshed the Wine-Wayland/EM-11 patch set with fullscreen, focus, scaling, pointer, IME, colorspace, and deadlock fixes.
  - Stopped automatically showing DXVK shader compiler text unless explicitly requested through DXVK_HUD.

  Video And Audio

  - Fixed a race in Media Foundation source-reader cleanup that could break Street Fighter 6 cutscenes unless debug logging was
    enabled.
  - Rebased the GE FFmpeg/WineDMO video playback patches onto the updated Wine base.
  - Added socket validation needed to avoid the Killing Floor 3 video-related crash.
  - Continued the long-running WinePulse timing recovery work for audio streams.
  - Packaged the PipeWire ALSA plugin for both x86_64 and aarch64 as it's useful for some games and the DS5 haptics audio device enumeration

  Controller Support

  - Finalized DualShock 4, DualSense, and DualSense Edge haptics, controller-speaker audio, and hotplug handling.
  - Fixed controller audio and endpoint handling when switching between Sony controller models.
  - Added support for Sony controller functionality in non-Sony titles such as Assassin’s Creed Shadows, Mirage, Valhalla, and
    Black Flag Resynced.
  - Added DualSense-to-DualShock 4 spoofing.
  - Added Sony HID-to-XInput conversion, including conventional two-motor rumble translation.
  - Added an ISteamInput006 compatibility fallback for games that require Steam Input.
  - Fixed Black Desert controller detection and startup crashes.
  - Added Monster Hunter Wilds controller and USB audio handling.

  Game Fixes

  - Fixed the Star Citizen unsupported-OS message-box crash and its condition check.
  - Disabled executable ASLR for Assassin’s Creed Revelations to handle its dynamic executable relocation behavior.
  - Improved the Monster Hunter Wilds save import fix so missing Steam userdata paths no longer cause Protonfixes errors.
  - Added or updated fixes for Dungeon Town, Heroes Chronicles, ESO, Heroes of Newerth Reborn, LEGO Marvel Super Heroes 2, and
    several other titles.
  - Made the ICU forwarder stubs prefer native DLLs to fix a launcher crash in Cyberpunk 2077
  - Removed old game-drive exceptions and added stricter Steam library path validation.
  - Added numeric UMU_ID fallback, so umu-123456 can supply app ID 123456 when SteamGameId is unavailable.

  ARM64

  - Backported LLVM-mingw ARM64X support.
  - Updated the ARM64 Steam Runtime SDK.
  - Enabled ARM64X DXVK and VKD3D-Proton modules.
  - Fixed Meson linker flag propagation for cross-compiled projects.

Next, a deeper explanation of the new controller options:

These are mainly introduced for usage outside of steam, although they can also be useful within steam when steam-input isn't working as well as it could or when wine-wayland is being used and subsequently steam controller profile switching can't be used due to the overlay not working in wine-wayland.

  First, disable Steam Input:

  1. Open the game’s Steam Properties.
  2. Select Controller.
  3. Set the per-game override to Disable Steam Input.

 NOTE:  When running outside Steam, Steam Input is already absent.


  ### OPTION 1: DS4 Spoof

  `PROTON_SONY_DUALSENSE_AS_DUALSHOCK4=1 %command%`

  Function:  Wine presents the DualSense or Edge as a real DS4, including the DS4 device identity and report layout. This normally
  preserves the game’s native PlayStation mappings and DS4 icons. This is useful for games that have full DS4 support but are missing DS5/DS5 Edge support.

  Example use cases:

  - Assassin’s Creed Odyssey
  - Assassin’s Creed Origins
  - Assassin’s Creed III Remastered, including Liberation Remastered

  ### OPTION 2: XInput Convert

  `PROTON_SONY_HIDRAW_XINPUT=1 %command%`

  Function: Wine converts DS4, DualSense, or DualSense Edge input into a correctly mapped XInput controller. Conventional XInput rumble is translated back to the Sony controller. This does not alter the game’s artwork, so the game may continue displaying Xbox or otherwise incorrect icons. This is for games whose Sony controller handling produces incorrect mappings, commonly because their controller profiles or icon support are incomplete. Typical incorrect game behavior will detect the controller, but show Xbox icons due to PS icons not being implemented in the game, and mappings also being incorrect.
  
  Examples:

  - Assassin’s Creed II
  - Assassin’s Creed Revelations
  - Assassin’s Creed IV: Black Flag
  - Black Desert Online

  ### OPTION 3: Steam Input Fallback

```
  PROTON_SONY_HIDRAW_XINPUT=1 \
  PROTON_STEAMINPUT_XINPUT_FALLBACK=1 \
  %command%
```
  Function:  Provides a compatible fake Steam Input device and forwards XInput controllers and mappings to it. For Sony
  controllers, it works with XInput Convert: the Sony input is first mapped correctly to XInput, then exposed through the fake
  Steam Input device. For non PS controllers that already register themselves as XInput devices, it just forwards the device as the Steam input device. This is For games with a hard dependency on Steam Input that need to run without the Steam client or with steam input disabled.  It is also useful under Wine-Wayland when Steam Input profile switching cannot operate because the Steam overlay is unavailable or broken.

  Example:

  - Monster Hunter Wilds



These modes are automatically enabled for the currently known affected Steam app IDs, but the environment variables remain
  available for testing and newly discovered games.

None of these options should be needed for games that have proper, full DS4 + DS5 + DS5 Edge support.

`PROTON_SONY_HIDRAW_XINPUT=1` Should be most useful for older games that either only have partial PS controller support without proper icons, or no PS controller support at all.

`PROTON_STEAMINPUT_XINPUT_FALLBACK=1` Should rarely need to be used. As far as I know the only use case I've found is Monster Hunter Wilds, which is a steam-only PC game anyway, so steam input should work correctly there to begin with. In case it doesn't this will work with steam input disabled on the game (for example if you want to use wine-wayland -and- have full controller support).

name: GE-Proton11-3 Released
body:
GE-Proton11-3:

This is a hotfix release:

- Fixes a bug where the steam desktop global virtual device would still be recognized in-game when wine-wayland was enabled, causing incorrect mappings and double input. Steam Overlay does not work in wine-wayland and subsequently neither does Steam Input since it requires the overlay for profile assignment. (It has always been this way since wine-wayland was added), but now with the desktop profile out of the way the controller input should behave the same as native wine expects it to when wine-wayland is enabled.  This does not appear to be a problem with wine-wayland disabled even if steam input is disabled.

- Fixes compilation failure on aarch64 due to an architecture specific code difference in the wineopenxr decoupling patch (this patch allows VR to work outside of steam)

- Fixes compilation failure on aarch64 due to the new nvidia libraries only being buildable on x86_64 -- they've been disabled on aarch64.


GE-Proton11-2:

I did not have enough time to do thorough regression testing for video playback after making recent changes, however several games that had video playback issues in 11-1 have since been fixed.
